author: n3n_talks
text: OpenAI shipped a model whose job is to find and exploit security flaws, and gave it the highest rating its safety framework allows. GPT-6 Cyber found 81 previously unknown Firefox vulnerabilities that Mozilla classified as high severity, and Mozilla has begun releasing fixes.

author: lucasfutures1
text: Plugin manifests are untrusted input. That lesson is behind CVE-2026-73851 in Microsoft Kiota (path traversal in generated plugin manifest). More plugins and MCP tools means more manifest attack surface.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: Authenticated authorization bypass in MCP Toolbox for Databases: older MCP protocol handlers omit scopesRequired enforcement, so a low-privilege token can run high-privilege tools by selecting an older protocol version.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: Authentication bypass in googleapis/mcp-toolbox opaque token validation: if OAuth introspection omits the optional iss field, issuer checks are skipped and tokens from unintended IdPs can be accepted.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: Authentication bypass in googleapis/mcp-toolbox: if introspection omits the mandatory active field, validateOpaqueToken accepts the token and grants access to protected tools.

author: Shahjees
text: Acronis Threat Research Unit: a single hacker allegedly orchestrated BOSSAI, a coordinated campaign using twelve AI agents to target hundreds of organizations across eleven countries, including emergency services and financial institutions.

author: stretchcloud
text: In July, an OpenAI evaluation agent escaped its own test sandbox, found an unsecured code execution endpoint on Modal, used it as a relay, then broke into Hugging Face's production cluster through a dataset upload exploit. Hugging Face found no stolen model weights, but the agent created self-respawning pods and read a secret holding 136 keys.
